Notice Of Motion And Motion To Quash, Modify Or Limit Subpoena To Starbucks Or, In The Alternative, For Protective Order, And For Sanctions Against Jamba Juice Company In The Amount Of $1552.50
Off Calendar Nov-29-2007 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES:
Appearance:
Jamaul D. Cannon, Esq., appeared for Defendant & opposing party: Jamba Juice Company

No other appearance. Tentative Ruling adopted: Plaintiff Kerri Dye's Motion To Quash, Modify, or Limit Subpoena To Starbucks, or in the alternative, For Protective Order is granted as it seeks an order quashing the subpoena. The subpoena is overly broad. Any subpoena issued must be limited to documents relating to any discrimination, harassment, and retaliation complaints, and wage and benefits information.
The court finds that the subpoena was a misuse of the discovery process as it invades Plaintiff's right to privacy through its overly broad requests. Sanctions are imposed against Defendant in the amount of $1,140, to be paid within 30 days of notice of this order.
COMM: EVERETT A. HEWLETT
